outcome: Mean token-level P(original role) over frozen target-body tokens, then equal mean across traces

source_validation.unique_inputs_per_trace: 1 + 7m, where m is the number of actually present source roles
source_validation.absent_source_roles: Missing observations (NA), never fabricated or assigned probability zero
source_validation.destination_wrappers: Same-trace native wrapper first; otherwise the frozen pilot catalog; all five destinations per present source
source_validation.body_token_identity_validation: Identity is checked against saved native IDs by the independent validator and token-curve loader

opaque_terminal_context.policy: Entire final failed generation/open header is unlabelled context; eligible movement ends before it

bootstrap.method: single-trace descriptive analysis; no confidence intervals
bootstrap.missing_roles: Excluded from the role-specific denominator; never assigned zero probability.

limitations: Only the first occurrence of each role in a trace is intervened on.
Removing or replacing a full role wrapper may also shift the body's absolute token position.
Moving an intact body and wrapper changes causal context and message order, not only position encoding.
Probe probability changes describe this checkpoint and trace set; they are not causal contribution percentages.
Averaged probabilities do not establish whether every token or trace changed in the same way.
IPI is one external dataset cohort; no FIT/DEV/TEST split or training-trace support is fabricated.
A missing source role is NA. Alternative wrappers may use the frozen pilot catalog when absent from the same trace.
Shared fixture templates can correlate tasks; trace-bootstrap intervals are not template-family uncertainty estimates.

A final invalid_native_response is retained with its open header as opaque context. Its tokens supply no role labels, source bodies or replacement wrappers, and no later simulated tool response is generated.

Movement ends at the farthest eligible parsed-prefix boundary, before any open header or opaque terminal suffix; displayed positions are divided by the full observed trace length, including that suffix.
